resources.string: Display only: live changes do not alter the recorded file or restart the microphone. Peak/RMS shows sample peak and instantaneous RMS. VU uses 300 ms ballistics; quasi-PPM uses a fast attack and slow return. VU and PPM are sine-peak calibrated. Reference sets 0 VU. Hold retains the displayed value independently per channel. These are not LUFS, true-peak, analog calibration or hardware compliance measurements. Only current PCM, no older than 500 ms, is displayed; clip is independent of mode.
